This file contains instructions for GitHub Copilot.

Always comment in English

This project is a demonstration of high-performance computations in pure Java 25. It has a strong focus on code readability and maintainability as well as performance. There is no committed public API, so the structure of the codebase is free to change as needed to best achieve these goals. The project is not intended for production use, but rather as a learning resource and demonstration of what is possible with modern Java.

Use modern Java 25 language features and APIs whenever they enhance conciseness and readability.

The APIs and documentation use precise and consistent English.
